title: Try to Hum With Your Nose Closed. You Can't

scenes.text: Try to hum with your nose closed. You can't.
Go ahead, pinch your nose and hum.
You'll stop in about two seconds.
Humming is just air moving out through your nose while your mouth stays shut.
Block the nose, and the air has nowhere to go, so the sound dies the moment the pressure builds.
Now you know. And now you know what to try on everyone you meet today.

description:
Humming is air leaving through your nose with your mouth closed. Pinch your nose and the sound stops within a couple of seconds.
Try it, then try it on someone else.
How long did you last?
